The '''Sipsk system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" /> The system was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Sipsk'ud]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="DiSPoL" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sipsk system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square N-4.<ref name="TEA" />
